items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: The interviewee (Sal Gutierrez) only responds to the interviewer's detailed narration of the Cassard family history with a brief comment about a different person ('He didn't know Cass, Joe the Cass...'). The interviewee does not claim any personal interaction, relationship, or direct knowledge of Ju

ctx.x: And Jules Cassard was her brother and he wrote Angry. And he's getting royalties. Yeah, he's living in Florida and he's getting royalties on Angry.
